verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents defining custom schemas to extract structured JSON (gh-14). It also offers LLM-driven structured data extraction with any LLM (gh-1) and CSS-, XPath- or LLM-based structured extraction (docs-2), so the core story is delivered. The evidence is only one-line feature claims, and the schema feature is described for repetitive page patterns rather than explicitly as standard JSON Schema input. missing for 10: explicit documentation of passing a JSON Schema (or Pydantic model) and getting schema-conformant output, details on validation and conformance guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.
